classification: Post-hoc saved-forecast diagnostic on previously examined development and retrospective outcomes; not a prospective test
selection: Lowest mean development seven-day USD quantile pinball, exact ties prefer identity then smallest sum(abs(log(multiplier))) then lexicographic multipliers
training_checkpoint_selection: Reuse original v14 selection; never reselect weights
matched_control: Apply the same nine-candidate calibration selection rule independently to each corresponding untuned and selected-SFT saved forecast
eligibility: Exactly all 20 development and 22 retrospective seven-day cases per arm/seed; no performance-based exclusions
transformation: Preserve q50 exactly; scale q10/q90 log-price offsets around q50 by positive lower/upper multipliers; preserve original values exactly for unit multipliers
failure: Nonfinite/nonpositive transformed values revert to the original triplet and count a failure; no dropping cells
success_diagnostic: At least 50% reduction of the original SFT-minus-base gap and positive gap reduction on at least two of three retrospective origins; this is descriptive only, not a claim of future improvement
